reserveReview.rationale: The complete issuer collateral payload at source timestamp 1790830837 (2026-10-01T05:00:37Z) discloses totalBackingAssetsInUsd of $4,946,709,944.87. Independently summed rows reconcile exactly in integer USD cents: Liquid Cash $4,016,882,398.87; ETH and liquid-staking assets $376,033,775; BTC $487,054,055; SOL, XRP, BNB and Gold $66,739,716. Existing adapter buckets round to 81.3/7.6/9.8/1.3%, totaling 100% without an invented balance. This is the issuer's whole backing-assets denominator, not a normalized selected subset, category-denominated lending collateral, or the monthly assurance balance sheet. The category API is separate non-additive context, with a different total and no constituent balances; no category fraction is multiplied into Liquid Cash and no tracked-asset allocation is inferred. Historical 2026-09-29 disclosure was $4,909,493,244.78 with weights 81.1/7.6/9.9/1.4; its review was dated 2026-09-30. No current strategy-wide stressed cash-out bound was established.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Complete issuer collateral positions payload; USD amounts summed against its disclosed totalBackingAssetsInUsd at timestamp 1790830837 (2026-10-01T05:00:37Z). Existing adapter source-key buckets, independent division and one-decimal rounding; category disclosure remains non-additive context.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The 81.3% Liquid Cash basket remains allocation-unresolved. Named stablecoins and tokenized funds in the separate category endpoint lack per-asset balances and a reconciled cross-endpoint checkpoint. No favorable constituent classification or dependency allocation follows from the refreshed backing-assets denominator.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The separate category API names USDT, USDC, USDtb and PYUSD in Liquid Stables, and JAAA/STAC in RWA, without constituent balances. Its denominator differs from the complete collateral endpoint. Retain research candidates without quantifying or multiplying category fractions into the Liquid Cash basket.
Delta-hedged ETH and liquid-staking-token backing is an external crypto, staking, and derivatives exposure, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.
Delta-hedged BTC backing is an external crypto and derivatives exposure, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.

The existing adapter's explicitly enumerated other bucket includes SOL, XRP, BNB and Gold at the reviewed snapshot. No Gold token identity or per-position hedge is inferred, and no tracked stablecoin dependency is allocated.

sources.label: Ethena August custodian report (2026-08-26 snapshot, published 2026-09-03)

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Ethena names Copper, Ceffu, and Fireblocks as off-exchange settlement providers and states that protocol assets remain beneficially owned by the protocol, while Copper and Ceffu use commingled omnibus wallets. Provider allocation shares across the stablecoin, DeFi lending, RWA, institutional lending, and crypto-basis categories, and contractual outcomes in each provider or exchange insolvency, are not public. The issuer custodian report published 2026-09-03 also names Anchorage Digital Bank and Kraken Custody at its 2026-08-26 snapshot, plus Coinbase on-chain wallets and an Ethena FalconX SPV using Anchorage and BitGo. These dated observations are not current allocation shares or proof of uniform custody arrangements across the strategy basket; the historical off-exchange provider roster is retained.
